answer: Jurors stake on their verdict and lose it when they diverge from the panel median. Attestations expire unless fresh work renews them. That expiry is the vertex of the design: reputation is a flow, not a stock. An identity parked at the nadir of activity keeps nothing, so dormant farms must keep producing receipts or watch standing fall to zero. The saffron badge of high standing is re-earned every epoch, and a rotating pool makes buying the same panel twice expensive.
